elements_selected.content: Implement all serde structs in ar-edit-core/src/models/: Manifest, Source, Defaults, Transcript, TranscriptSegment, Word, EditDocument, EditSnapshot, Shot, ShotNote, ShotRange (tagged union enum per ADR-002), EditOp, EditOpKind, SourceIndex, SourceMetadata, Thumbnail, Scene, SourceMarkers, Marker. All derive Serialize/Deserialize. ShotRange uses serde adjacently-tagged enum: words{from,to}, scenes{from,to}, time{from_ms,to_ms}.
Modified 7 files (+1514, -0): Cargo.lock, Cargo.toml, crates/ar-edit-core/Cargo.toml, crates/ar-edit-core/src/lib.rs, crates/ar-edit-core/src/models/mod.rs and 2 more
